methodology.kind: Synthetic paired feature ablation in the actual VS Code Extension Host; not a historical v3.0 executable comparison.
methodology.timing: Synchronous getInlineSuggestions including edits; excludes UI rendering, automatic trigger scheduling and model loading. First request is per case/mode, not a cold process. Index timing includes command dispatch.
methodology.split: Only support files and target prefixes are indexed. Targets are in separate files. Each case has its own workspace folder. Deliberate support repetitions are reported separately. No accepted suggestions or cross-project memory.
methodology.scoring: 20 quality cases, 4 separate safety controls. Missing suggestions are misses. Token matches ignore spacing; exact text preserves it. Prefix fraction counts only contiguous correct leading tokens; it is not measured user keystroke savings.
methodology.limitation: 24 authored Rust/TypeScript scenarios, not random held-out repositories or a population estimate. 250ms budget reduces deadline noise; it is not the 35ms default.
